cohort: 192 pregnant women with rheumatic heart disease (RHD) at Menoufia University Hospital, Egypt, divided into low- and high-risk groups based on NYHA functional classification.
finding: Women with RHD and NYHA class III/IV experienced poorer maternal outcomes (more heart failure, arrhythmias, thromboembolism, ICU admissions, cesarean deliveries, and lactation problems) and more premature births/NICU admissions compared to those with NYHA class I/II.
mod_finding: Women with NYHA class III/IV had more cesarean deliveries compared to those with NYHA class I/II.
